records.rawText: Our world is increasingly becoming dependent on technology and the volume of data generated and shared across the Internet between people, devices, and software is exploding. Technology adoption use is growing across all areas of life and a number of fields - including work and play, banking, medicine, education and more. Due to the growth in technology use, vast amounts of information are being stored & shared across digital devices - requiring evolving security measures and responsible use.

The internship provides valuable real-world experience with a competitive stipend, expediting your journey towards becoming a Chartered Accountant (Singapore). This hands-on experience significantly contributes to the mandatory three-year practical experience required for qualification. Moreover, our dynamic curriculum offers exemptions from specific Singapore Chartered Accountant Qualification (SCAQ) professional exams, allowing you to accumulate professional experience seamlessly while pursuing your degree. Take the opportunity to elevate your aspirations, redefine your academic journey, and emerge as a trailblazer in the accountancy world with our forward-thinking programme. records.rawText: For over 70 years, the National Institute of Education has played a central role in preparing educators who are equipped with disciplinary expertise, research-informed perspectives, and professional competence. NIE’s emphasis on educational research enables teachers to engage critically with environmental, social, and spatial challenges in a rapidly changing world. Within this framework, the Geography major provides a well-rounded education in Geography as an academic discipline, focusing on the three key strands of Human Geography, Physical Geography, and Geographical Techniques. By the end of the programme, you will be equipped with content knowledge in both Human and Physical Geography, as well as technical competencies in data analytics, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and remote sensing. You will also be trained in field methods. In addition, the department’s flagship Sustainability Learning Lab provides a nurturing platform for student teachers and staff to connect through shared interests in sustainability and sustainable development. NIE is ranked #3 in Asia and #8 globally for Education in the 2025 QS World University Rankings by Subject.

records.rawText: Singapore’s education system is internationally recognised for its excellence, and the National Institute of Education (NIE) has been at the heart of this success. For over 70 years, NIE has played a pivotal role in initial teacher preparation and continual professional development, equipping future educators with the skills, knowledge, and values needed to thrive in a dynamic educational landscape. Grounded in strong educational research, NIE prepares teachers and learners alike to adapt confidently to change and innovation. The Art Major is designed to develop learners’ competencies in Visual Art through a strong foundation in studio practice and critical studies. Students engage with a diverse range of visual art courses spanning 2D and 3D media, contemporary digital technologies, and art theories. Learning takes place in well-equipped, purpose-built studios, guided by accomplished artists and experts in the field. The programme culminates in an arts-based research project, where students develop their personal artistic voice and produce a body of work for public exhibition—preparing them to become confident, independent practitioners and reflective educators in the visual arts. NIE is ranked #3 in Asia and #8 globally for Education in the 2025 QS World University Rankings by Subject.
